estimates.assumptions: 400 ml whole milk (standard assumption); ~4.8 g carbs per 100 ml
150 ml double cream; ~3 g carbs per 100 ml
1 cinnamon stick used only for infusion and discarded; nutritional contribution negligible, treated as null
Zest from 1 orange used only for infusion and strained out; nutritional contribution negligible, treated as null
Zest from 1 lemon used only for infusion and strained out; nutritional contribution negligible, treated as null
7 large egg yolks (~17 g each, 119 g total); ~1.8 g carbs per 100 g
6 tbsp caster sugar (~75 g total, 12.5 g per tbsp); 75 g carbohydrates
45 g cornflour/cornstarch; ~97 g carbs and ~2.6 g fiber per 100 g
